evidence.quoted_text: const known = observation?.usage !== undefined && usage !== undefined;
evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the known-usage decision still has no usage-provenance guard: src/ops/review/addressMany.ts:664 marks a leg known whenever the normalized observation/usage counters are present. An unmeasured dispatch whose driver returns zero counters normalizes as present, so the leg can be counted as known, inflating knownCount and allowing settlement/admission to proceed without the unknown-usage stop. The requested per-leg provenance flag is not applied here.
